selection_rule: Import independent fixes and compatible features selectively; preserve Hollycast behavior and V63 save compatibility. Defer broad translation, platform, and runtime-dependent work for focused review.
compatibility: Savestate field validation preserves serialized field order and V63 layout.
Hollycast DreamLink and pending GD-ROM target serialization remain unchanged.
Libretro serialize-size estimation changes buffer sizing only; it does not change state bytes.
Hollycast Capcom Direct and custom-service behavior was retained in the BBA/network service integration.
RA popup preferences use a separate achievements option and do not alter RA enablement, credentials, or hardcore state.

validation.source_review: All 54 range commits plus master-only 53ef were dispositioned. Hollycast-specific customizations and V63 state compatibility were preserved.

validation.tests: Final macOS arm64 Ninja run passed 197/197 tests with --gtest_filter=-*HttpTest*. Six HttpTest cases were excluded because they make remote postb.in requests. This includes 4 NetworkServiceTest cases and 5 LibretroHelpersTest cases, covering RX startup/reset/clock gating, timing coalescing/reset, and serialization padding. A separate macOS arm64 LIBRETRO=ON build of Hollycast_libretro succeeded; its standalone LibretroHelpersTest run passed 5/5. Enabling the full test target for LIBRETRO exposed missing imgui.h and SDL.h headers in unrelated existing tests, so those full tests were not run in that configuration.
limitations: No Windows/UWP runtime build was available; MoveFileExW's UWP availability was checked against Microsoft Learn.
No ARM64 hardware run was available for the deferred NEON framebuffer optimization.
CMake configuration in this environment depends on local submodules; the rendering agent's configured macOS test build is the validated test path.
